title: Odoo Real Estate Module
subtitle: Hands-on bootcamp project — learning Odoo modular development
summary: Built a real estate module from scratch as part of the Odoo Technical Bootcamp. This was a practical learning project focused on understanding how Odoo's ORM, models, views, and business logic work together in a real ERP module.
highlights: Practiced Odoo model inheritance, field types, and relational data (Many2one, One2many)
Built property listing and sales tracking views with custom workflow stages
Applied business logic using @api.constrains to enforce pricing and offer rules

title: KPI Reporting Dashboard
subtitle: Concept project — currently exploring
summary: A planned reporting project to practice building an end-to-end data pipeline: pulling raw data, cleaning it with Power Query, then presenting operational KPIs in a Power BI dashboard — the kind of reporting that supports ERP and operations teams.
highlights: Power Query ETL: cleaning and structuring raw operational data
Pandas for more complex transformations and data validation
Power BI dashboard focused on actionable KPI summaries
